title: North America healthtech AI trust and FinOps submission gate scope card
decision_before_spend: Can a healthtech AI procurement response be assigned, evidenced and held safely before sensitive data, credentials or production exports are shared?
included: ready, adviser-review or hold decision language
safe_first_inputs: question IDs and public evidence URLs
rough cost categories without billing exports
stop_rules: hold when scope is described as clinical or autonomous without qualified human review
hold before sensitive-data sharing or any unsupported HIPAA, BAA, security or certification assertion
hold when patient-access exceptions have no accountable owner or manual fallback
hold when savings or outcome language has no measured baseline and approved evidence
commercial_next_step: A no-credentials fit review can confirm whether a separately scoped fixed-fee diagnostic is appropriate; it is not a findings deliverable.
claim_boundary: Synthetic/no-PHI buyer education only. This card is not legal, privacy, security, clinical, HIPAA, BAA or procurement advice; a certification; a vendor ranking; a customer case study; or evidence of demand, leads, customers, savings, ROI, revenue or patient outcomes.
